about: Well-known open problems the swarm works toward. Maintainers add to this list by pull request. Problems the ledger found while checking candidates are NOT copied here: they are read from ledger/routed-open-problems.md. See problems/README.md.

problems.title: The Riemann hypothesis
problems.statement: Do all non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function have real part 1/2?

problems.title: The Collatz (3x+1) conjecture
problems.statement: Does iterating n -> n/2 for even n and n -> 3n+1 for odd n reach 1 from every positive integer?

problems.title: Erdős's conjecture on arithmetic progressions
problems.statement: Does every set of positive integers whose reciprocals have a divergent sum contain arithmetic progressions of every finite length?

source.title: Breaking the logarithmic barrier in Roth's theorem on arithmetic progressions

problems.note: The case of three-term progressions follows from the cited paper; the conjecture for every length is open.

problems.title: Yang-Mills existence and mass gap
problems.statement: Does a quantum Yang-Mills theory exist on four-dimensional space-time for every compact simple gauge group, and does it have a mass gap?

problems.title: The nature of dark matter
problems.statement: What is the dark matter that astronomical observations require made of?

problems.title: The mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity
problems.statement: What pairs the electrons in the copper-oxide superconductors, and what sets their transition temperature?

source.title: From quantum matter to high-temperature superconductivity in copper oxides

problems.title: P versus NP
problems.statement: Can every problem whose solution is verifiable in polynomial time also be solved in polynomial time?

problems.title: The exponent of matrix multiplication
problems.statement: Is the exponent omega of matrix multiplication equal to 2?

source.title: A Refined Laser Method and Faster Matrix Multiplication

problems.title: Graph isomorphism in polynomial time
problems.statement: Can it be decided in polynomial time whether two finite graphs are isomorphic?

problems.title: The origin of life
problems.statement: How and where did life on Earth arise?

problems.title: Organ regeneration
problems.statement: What controls organ regeneration, and why can some animals regrow organs that others cannot?

problems.title: Species diversity
problems.statement: What determines how many species live in a place?

problems.title: Peto's paradox
problems.statement: Why does cancer risk not rise across species with body size and lifespan, although larger and longer-lived animals have more cell divisions in which to acquire mutations?

source.title: Peto's Paradox: evolution's prescription for cancer prevention

problems.title: An effective HIV vaccine
problems.statement: Is a vaccine that reliably prevents HIV infection feasible?
